tool-task-handoff-dispatch.title: Tool brought into this task
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.boundary: This checks the exact tool configuration. Task compatibility, model, budget and formal preview still require review below; no task starts automatically.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.idle: Choose to check the original configuration before adopting it.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.reading: Reading this exact tool under current access…
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.adopted: The checked configuration was adopted. Review the current selection and model settings below.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.changed: The original configuration changed or is unavailable. Return to the tool details to check it; a different version was not substituted.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.forbidd: Current access or this tool is unavailable. No configuration was adopted.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.unknown: The configuration could not be confirmed. Check again explicitly.
